links.outcome: EHR time, documentation time, and weekly visit volume after AI scribe adoption versus non-adopters
links.effect: AI scribe adoption associated with 13.4 (95% CI, 9.1-17.7) fewer minutes of EHR time, 16.0 (13.7-18.3) fewer minutes documentation time, 0.49 (0.17-0.81) additional weekly visits; after-hours EHR time unchanged.
links.quote: In a difference-in-differences analysis, AI scribe adoption was associated with 13.4 (95% CI, 9.1-17.7) fewer minutes of EHR time, 16.0 (95% CI, 13.7-18.3) fewer minutes of documentation time, and 0.49 (95% CI, 0.17-0.81) additional weekly visits delivered.

screen.reason: Empirical cohort study across five health systems measuring the real-world impact of adopting an ambient AI scribe on clinician EHR documentation time and visit volume.
